usage.guide: This endpoint is currently broken. GET https://market.memoryapi.org/x402/market/news_sentiment returns a 502 Bad Gateway (nginx) for all requests, both with and without a ?symbol= query param, and never serves an x402 payment challenge. Do not attempt to call or pay it until the upstream backend is restored. When live, it is expected to accept a ticker symbol (likely ?symbol=AAPL) and return aggregated news sentiment for that ticker for $0.005 on Base.
